purpose: Corpus-wide grouping and holdout policy for the unified source recovery effort. Groups reference content hashes; classification evidence is reused from the existing manifest, never duplicated here.
manifest_summary: 900 files, 894 unique contents, 402 dynamic, 498 static, 0 unknown/malformed (recorded evidence; not a re-scan).
deduplication: Same sha256 counts as one sample regardless of path; pasteboard appears in both roots under one identity.

membership.rule: Resolve membership before method selection: a holdout hash is excluded from every development path alias and pool. Explicit named development cohorts precede the residual pool. Contradictory named families require reconciliation, not duplicate evidence.

independent_method_candidates.reason: Method-level ABC inspection pending; file identity alone is not capability evidence.
Method-level ABC inspection pending; no call shape is inferred from the application name.
Method-level ABC inspection pending; all required capabilities must occur in the selected whole method.

cohorts.role: First vertical slice and fixed regression subset (19 records / 219 methods). Tuning on these inputs is allowed.
Cross-application ArkUI/class/lifecycle stress sample; also the first non-12.0.6 profile evidence source.

cohorts.cross_application_note: modules.abc and widgets.abc belong to one application family and never count as two independent cross-application evidences.

cohorts.role: First independent-application holdout. No rule tuning against these inputs until a frozen implementation is verified; any earlier holdout failure moves the input to the regression set and a fresh holdout is selected.
cohorts.candidate_methods: Identity not yet frozen; select by content hash + entity after the method-level route exists (T01+). Do not guess entities.

cohorts.inputs: batch-manifest contents after hash-based holdout and named-development exclusions
cohorts.leakage_note: Application family is unknown for anonymous files; any cross-application claim built on them must be flagged as unproven family association.

profile_layering.rule: Historical profiles never use v7 rules without pinned per-profile evidence; multiple applications on one profile do not count as cross-profile validation. Where a real corpus lacks a profile, existing historical fixtures cover it and the gap is recorded.

static_inputs.policy: Persisted skip per abc-index evidence; never counted as source-recovery success; unknown/malformed/decode-failure are never classified static.

status.hash_verification_method: sha256sum read-only over the five paired inputs; all five match abc-index.json entries under corpus_id paired
status.notes: No batch validation, JS execution or RSS measurement has run; those remain suspended by the user.
